svg.text: texture in ink: bark, water, cloth — one pen, three languages
I. BARK — chop: short strokes, off-vertical, clustered
crevices are dark wedges; plates break horizontally
II. WATER — flow: one breath, sine rhythm, broken dashes
amplitude 4–11px · the leaf is the only thing allowed a curve
III. CLOTH — weave: fold bands, 8px crosses, valley stipple
light is just paper left alone — ink only describes the dark
the stroke alphabet — each language's signature stroke, enlarged
chop · 15–45px, off-vertical, clustered — wedges go dark
flow · one breath, sine rhythm 4–14px — breaks read as sparkle
weave · crosses on the light, bands + stipple in the dark
what it taught: texture is rhythm, not detail — direction + spacing + weight; the subject barely matters
